Tennis player: rejected head floats off a sloping torso and the racket is too small. Enlarge head/racket, align neck tangent, preserve forehand stance.
Fidget spinner: rejected outline is angular and lacks all three outer bearing holes. Restore smooth three-lobe outline and bearings.
Propeller: rejected lower blades are angular and hub oversized. Use round blade ends and balanced blade lengths.
Trees: rejected rear trees have no trunks and read as mountain peaks. Restore layered tree silhouettes and three trunks.
Goat: rejected horns are short hooks, face is broad and the third eye a dot. Restore curling horns, tapered muzzle and a distinct third eye.
Tuxedo: rejected bow is oversized and jacket cropped into a box. Restore narrow bow and long tapered jacket/lapels.
Hand-holding pair: rejected outside arms are rigid horizontal bars and heads too small. Restore sloping arms, larger heads and a joined central hand.
Children: rejected heads have no hairlines and resemble rings. Restore parted hair and a readable ponytail.
Intersecting circles: rejected circles are tall ovals. Restore rounder overlapping circles and clear central lens.
Envelopes: rejected back envelope lacks its flap and front corners are square. Restore two flap cues and rounded sheet corners.
Capped reader: rejected face resembles a barred circle and book is flat-bottomed. Restore cap silhouette and a deeper open-book fold.
Crowned visitor: rejected tent looks like a bottle and the shoulders are detached too far. Restore broad tent roof and body and closer natural bust.
Dog walker: rejected bag is a ring and dog is a bare angular stick. Restore hanging bag shape, dog head/back, and natural person proportions.
Horned dragon: rejected head is a long rectangle and the body an open squiggle. Restore a rounded snout and coherent S-curve through the curled body.
Dragon emblem: rejected dragon looks like a circular letter G. Restore pointed dragon head and stronger curved wing/tail silhouette.
Fox flame: rejected emblem is an open loop without fox head. Restore pointed ear, snout notch, flame crest and closed curling silhouette.
Field rows: rejected boundary follows rather than crosses the main rows, reading as generic stripes. Restore intersecting hillside and arcing crop rows.
Unrolled paper: rejected curl looks like a folded corner; top paper lip is absent. Restore a full-height roll and separated top edge.
Guitar: rejected waist is pinched, neck blocky and soundhole a solid dot. Restore smooth body transitions and visible soundhole.
Wrench: rejected head has angular shoulders and handle is too short. Restore round head-to-handle transitions and a longer slim grip.
